<$voicel(1,5)>Who do you think is heavier, me or <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>- Gostaste?

dialogues.en: <$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, OK... Well, let me know if you need something!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,8)>Está bem, diz-me se precisares de alguma coisa.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow...thanks! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)>Uau... obrigado!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Hee hee! Thanks so much...
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, it looks like I don’t have anything left... Uh, come

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,10)>Muito obrigado...
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, parece que eu não tenho mais nada... Ah, venha

<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! I’m off to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> now...
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hee hee... I can’t wait to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>!

<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! Eu estou indo para o <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1325)> Agora...

<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>... I’m sorry but, um... I think I’m out of

dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,1)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>... Sinto muito, mas, um... acho que estou fora

dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... Será que consigo comer isto?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Ooooooh! You made food for me? Thank you so much!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Fizeste comida para mim? Muito obrigado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Hi, good morning! It really IS a nice morning, isn’t it?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>The sun’s nice and warm, and now I get to chat with you
a little bit too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oi, bom dia! É realmente uma bela manhã, não é?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>O sol é agradável e quente, e agora eu posso conversar com você
Um pouco também!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>The clouds up in the sky look so light and fluffy... They
look delicious, don’t they?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>I wish I could grab one and just gobble it up...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>As nuvens no céu parecem tão leves e macias...
Parecem deliciosos, não?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Quem me dera poder ir buscar um e devorá-lo...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>The sun gets all red in the evening...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>You know, I bet that color means it’s all spicy and
delicious. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>I wanna lick it...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>O sol fica todo vermelho à noite...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>Você sabe, Eu aposto que a cor significa que é tudo picante e
Delicioso. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Quero lambê-lo...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>The moon looks like it’s about the same size as the
sun, right?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>So uh... Why is it that the sun’s so much brighter?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>A lua parece que é do mesmo tamanho que o
Sol, certo?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Então... porque é que o sol é tão mais brilhante?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I know I space out and get lost sometimes, <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>but I’ve
never panicked!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>See, I remember the scent of my home—all I need to do
is follow it and I know I’ll be just fine.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Sei que me perco às vezes. <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>mas eu tenho
Nunca entrei em pânico!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,38)>Lembro-me do cheiro da minha casa - tudo o que preciso fazer
é segui-lo e eu sei que eu vou ficar bem.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I found a bunch of delicious-looking berries scattered all
over the ground the other day.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>I miiight’ve grabbed one and eaten it...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>But now that I think about it, maybe someone was saving
them for a snack? <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Sorry about that, if they were yours...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Encontrei um monte de bagas deliciosas espalhadas.
No outro dia, no chão.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Eu miiight pegou um e comeu...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Mas agora que penso nisso, talvez alguém estivesse a salvar
para um lanche? <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Desculpe, se fossem seus...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I think it’s best to eat slowly. <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>That way I get to
enjoy delicious food for even longer!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Acho que é melhor comer devagar. <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Assim eu chego a...
desfrutar de deliciosa comida por mais tempo ainda!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, I guess that’s it for today. Well, I had a really
good time!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)>When should I do this again?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, eu acho que é isso por hoje. Bem, eu tinha um
Bom tempo!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)>Quando é que devo fazer isto outra vez?

like,
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(12)>
something
with me?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Vamos, por que você não,

algo

Maybe
I’ll go
say hi.

Talvez.
Eu vou.

dialogues.en:
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>When I look at the sun from underwater, it’s all squiggly
and pretty, y’know?
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>But then when I stick my face above the surface, it’s way
too bright! I just wanna see it up close, is all...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando eu olho para o sol debaixo d'água, é tudo esguio
E bonita, sabe?
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas então quando eu coloco meu rosto acima da superfície, é caminho
Só quero vê-lo de perto, é tudo...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, heya! I know you’ve been watering stuff here and
there lately.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>You’re really working hard, aren’t you,
<$cdef(27)>.
Maybe I
should
do
something too...

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Você está realmente trabalhando duro, não é,
<$cdef(27)>.
Talvez eu...
deve
fazer
Algo também...

dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Acabei de encontrar isto.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>I was just hanging out with <$cdef(27)>—they’re
really nice!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>They were so patient and <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>a great listener too.
Just like you, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,803)>Estava só a sair com... <$cdef(27)>—são
Muito bom!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Eles foram tão pacientes e <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Um grande ouvinte também.
Assim como tu, <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oooh, hi! You know
<$cdef(27)>
you
gave
me before?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)>I just wanted to say, really great! <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,9)>I’m so glad I asked
for ! Thanks again, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Olá!
<$cdef(27)>
você
dom

em vez Obrigado mais uma vez. <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, wowww! You really can make anything you want, can’t
you, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Oooh, I know! I bet you could make one of those houses
the humans used to live in.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’d just love to, you know, chill out in one of
those someday...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, wowww! Você realmente pode fazer o que quiser, não pode
você, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Aposto que podias fazer uma daquelas casas.
Os humanos costumavam viver.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Eu adoraria, você sabe, relaxar em um dos
aqueles que um dia...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh wow, when’d the sky get dark? It must be later than
I expected...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I guess I should go to bed soon. How about you,
<$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh wow, quando o céu ficou escuro? Deve ser mais tarde do que
Eu esperava...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Acho que devo ir para a cama em breve.
<$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Everyone keeps telling me morning walks are the best,
but I dunno...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I think I like the atmosphere at night better. <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)>Besides, I’m
always so sleepy in the morning... *yawn*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Toda a gente me diz que caminhadas matinais são as melhores.
Mas não sei...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Acho que gosto mais da atmosfera à noite. <$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,16)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,14)>Além disso, eu sou
Sempre tão sonolento de manhã...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>So you can transform, right, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,6)>Maybe one of these days you can transform into a flying
Pokémon and we can go explore the sky together.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, but I should warn you... I’m a lot faster than you might
think, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>so it might be hard for you to keep up.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Então você pode transformar, certo, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(1,6)>Talvez um dia destes possas transformar-te num voo.
Pokémon e nós podemos ir explorar o céu juntos.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, mas eu devo avisá-lo... Eu sou muito mais rápido do que você poderia
pensar, <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,666)>Por isso, pode ser difícil para ti acompanhar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>It’s so nice that nobody here’s afraid of me, even though
I’m poisonous.
<$voicel(1,6)>They happily gobble up <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>the snacks I share with them
and everything! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>É tão bom que ninguém aqui tem medo de mim, mesmo que
Sou venenosa.
<$voicel(1,6)>Eles devoram com alegria. <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>os petiscos que eu compartilho com eles
e tudo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>You know, I’m pretty proud of how squishy I am.
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Oh, but you seem pretty soft and smooshy too,
<$cdef(27)>...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I wonder which one of us is squishier. Maybe we can find
out by squashing each other?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Você sabe, eu estou muito orgulhoso de como sou mole.
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Mas tu também pareces muito suave e fofinho.
<$cdef(27)>...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Pergunto-me qual de nós é mais sensível.
Esmagando-nos uns aos outros?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>My body’s nice and hard, don’t you think? <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>I can get hit by
little rocks and stuff and it doesn’t hurt at all!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Oh, but please don’t go throwing rocks at me on
purpose, OK?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Meu corpo é agradável e duro, você não acha? <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>Eu posso ser atingido por
pequenas pedras e outras coisas e não dói em tudo!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Oh, mas por favor não vá jogando pedras em mim
propósito, está bem?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>You know, the other day I was just spacing out for a little
bit when a really strong wind kicked up...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>I got caught up and blown around a bit!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I guess tiny Pokémon like me gotta be more alert when
the wind’s strong...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>sabe, no outro dia eu estava só a espaçar um pouco.
Um pouco quando um vento muito forte começou...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>Fui apanhado e explodido um pouco!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Acho que o pequeno Pokémon como eu tem de estar mais alerta quando
o vento é forte...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I think I toss and turn a lot in my sleep. The other day,
<$voicel(1,6)>I tossed and turned my way clean out of my home <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>and
right into the middle of the pathway.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>I think I ended up blocking it up for a good while...
How embarrassing.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Acho que me viro muito enquanto durmo.
